affix.note: The prefix slot is owned by the country selector. Suffix icons go through the suffix input; interactive content uses the suffix-action slot with both [solaris-form-suffix] and [solaris-form-suffix-action].

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

clearable.label: Phone
clearable.note: With clearable, a clear button appears when the field has a value and emits cleared on click. It stays hidden while disabled, readonly, or loading.

countries.note: Open the prefix button to search and pick a country. Pass countryList to restrict the options and [searchable]="false" to hide the search box.

phone-field.description: Form Field preset for phone numbers with a searchable country selector, as-you-type formatting, and a single E.164 value. Composes Form Field + Input.

examples.note: Type a number to see it formatted as you type. The value is normalized to E.164 when valid.

form.label: Phone
form.note: Works with Reactive Forms through ControlValueAccessor. The model value is a single E.164 string; pair with solarisPhoneValidator.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the phone field component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius follows the global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: the inner Form Field owns the outer height while the preset keeps font and padding in sync.

states.note: Disabled and readonly are real, not visual-only. Loading renders a spinner overlay in the suffix slot without shifting the layout.

phone-field.title: Phone Field
